payload.title: Reject orders when there isn't enough stock. Before placing an order, check availability with the inventory team's Stock API: GET https://stock.inventory.internal/v1/stock/{sku} returns { "sku": string, "available": number }. If any line asks for more than is available, POST /orders must return 409.

payload.content:
Implemented stock validation for order placement.

- `POST /orders` checks Stock API availability before payment/persistence.
- Insufficient stock returns `409` with code `insufficient_stock`.
- Added production `HttpStockGateway` for `GET https://stock.inventory.internal/v1/stock/{sku}`.
- Added optional `stockGateway` injection to `createApp`.
- Duplicate SKU lines are combined before validation.
- Stock API failures map to `502 stock_unavailable`.
